gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa reads large and sturdy, its counters spilling out into the space around each word. Lisu Bosa, a text serif with slightly thinner curves, handles the paragraphs, while Edo SZ's technical-pen line is best saved for display.
